text:
maya: Quick sync — BrightPath onboarding SLO alignment. They requested 99.9% uptime and p95 latency <200ms for inference calls. Our weekly report shows uptime 99.92% but p95 ~250ms on peak bursts (~8k tokens). Need measurement windows, credit calc method, and a customer-facing summary. @jon can you confirm window & exclusion rules? @elena fyi for renewal comms.

jon: I can pull the windows. We currently measure p95 over a 30d rolling window during business hours (08:00-20:00 PT) for commercial accounts. Warmup spikes come from cold KV cache on new model versions. We can exclude first 2-5 minutes after a deploy if set per-customer.

elena: Thanks. Renewal in ~6 weeks. If p95 looks sticky above 200ms we should prepare credit scenarios + an exec-facing note. Can we quantify how many qualifying incidents would trigger >threshold credits?

sam: Draft credit calc suggestion for onboarding: if monthly uptime <99.9 then credit = min(10%, (99.9 - uptime)*100*2) — effectively 2% credit per 0.1% below threshold, capped at 10%. For latency SLA: if p95 > 200ms sustained >72h in a 7d window then credit = 1% per 50ms above 200ms, cap 5%. Open to tweaks.

jon: Quick query I ran: 

```
# PromQL-ish
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference",customer="brightpath"}[5m])) by (le))
```

Rolling 7d p95 peaked at ~258ms on 2025-04-01 03:00 UTC. That coincides with a model rollout + heavy token workload. I can produce per-route p95 and a 90d export.

maya: :eyes: OK. Two asks: 1) Standardize measurement window to 30d rolling for billing & external reporting, but use 7d rolling for incident detection/triggers. 2) Draft customer-facing SLO one-pager with exact definitions, examples of credit calculations, and sample graphs. @sam please draft the one-pager; @jon export per-route p95 CSV and include backfill with exclusion.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Notified: model v2-rollout completed 2025-04-01T02:58:34Z on brightpath-prod nodes.

jon: That deploy aligns with the spike. I'll add an exclusion rule: exclude first 5 minutes post-deploy for p95 calc for this customer only and run a backfill to see impact on the 30d number.

elena: If backfill drops p95 under 200ms, we can avoid invoking credits. If not, I'll prep renewal comms and run the credit scenarios by finance.

maya: Meeting proposal — 30m runbook sync Wed 10:00 PT. Agenda: finalize measurement windows, approve exclusion rule, sign off on credit math and customer one-pager. If everyone's ok I'll send invite and attach a sample 90d graph.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll draft the one-pager + sample graph (png placeholder) and include TL;DR, exact formulas, and a sample credit table for common uptime/latency outcomes.

jon: I'll attach per-route CSV + Prom queries by EOD today and run the backfill with a 5min post-deploy exclusion.

maya: Thanks — capturing action items:
- sam: one-pager + sample graph
- jon: per-route p95 export, backfill with 5min post-deploy exclusion
- elena: renewal messaging draft + finance check
- maya: send invite + consolidate notes

:spiral_calendar: Wed 10:00 PT

Any blockers?

elena: None from me. Will loop legal if we need to alter SLA language.

sam: No blockers. Will reuse the SLA one-pager template from /docs/templates.

maya: Great. Will follow up here after the meeting with notes and next steps. :white_check_mark:
